## About
Novitech Tuning specializes in service, repairs and performance upgrades for fine European cars like Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, VW, Bentley and Porsche. Due to popular demand, we also service most import and domestic vehicles, from Toyota and Honda to Ford and Chevy.
Our ASE Certified and factory trained team, including a Master Guild technician, handles everything from oil changes, brakes and A/C repairs to turbo and supercharger upgrades, fabrication and welding, and complete engine rebuilds.
Drivers rate us 4.8 from 290 Google reviews. We see customers from Kendall, Homestead, Pinecrest, Coral Gables, Doral and across South Florida, and we treat every car that comes through the door like it's our own.

## Services
- Oil change service: Along with the oil change, fluids are refilled if needed and tire pressures are set.
- Scheduled maintenance: Staying on top of your maintenance schedule helps avoid breakdowns and costly repairs, and protects the value of your car.
- Comprehensive diagnostic: Check engine light on? We track down the real cause so you don't pay for parts you didn't need.
- Wheel alignment: Alignments on a Hunter Engineering RX Hawkeye system with ride height targets, for even tire wear and a centered steering wheel.
- Tire services: Rotation and balancing, flat repairs, and mounting and balancing factory or aftermarket wheels with low profile tires.
- Engine repair and rebuilding: From head gaskets and oil pumps to compression tests and full rebuilds, engine work is a regular job in our shop.
- Engine performance: More performance, done safely and without giving up drivability or smoothness.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only work on European cars?
A: No. European cars are our specialty, but we also service most import and domestic vehicles, including Lexus, Nissan, Honda, Toyota, Subaru, Ford, Dodge and Chevy.

Q: Do you accept extended warranties?
A: We accept most extended warranties. Bring us your policy's contact information and one of our service advisors will take care of the rest.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're about 5 miles west of exit 19 (SW 120th St.) on the Florida Turnpike.

Q: Is there somewhere to wait while my car is worked on?
A: Yes. We have a comfortable customer lounge with a flat screen TV.
